monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The grinder guide now moves high-intent readers from a model-specific dry-fit and checkout record into the existing neutral ownership-cost calculator and complete gear comparison worksheet. No merchant, product, price, coupon, ranking, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: Both expanded pages use image-free records, tables, checklists, and source cards. The technical change alters navigation semantics only. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. The only supported position 4–20 non-brand content signal—Stem Cell CBG at 18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2—was materially reinforced on October 15, so repeating that cluster today would risk cannibalization. No Data-led item was selected. One-impression queries, HTTP-variant noise, four ashtray impressions, two guide-hub impressions, and the Oklahoma page at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak, noisy, or outside the target range.

authority.action: Rebuilt the tolerance and withdrawal page into a citation-worthy, non-diagnostic seven-day pattern record with official CDC, NIDA, SAMHSA, and 988 routes plus a peer-reviewed clinical review. Strengthened reciprocal responsible-use, medication, and mental-health paths. The navigation semantics gate adds a transparent trust and accessibility check. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
